items.title: The common symbiosis pathway controls plant root microbiomes in a host-specific manner
items.one_liner: Crop nutrition depends on plant-microbe interactions, yet it remains unclear whether conserved genetic pathways impose universal rules on root microbiome assembly across plant hosts. items.title: Integrated multi-omics decipher the complex nodule microbiota and distinct Frankiaceae symbiotic traits in wild actinorhizal plants.
items.one_liner: Actinorhizal plants are ecologically important pioneer species in temperate regions, capable of nitrogen-fixing root nodule symbiosis with Frankiaceae bacteria.
